Story / Acceptance Criteria: US2 AC1; US2 AC3; US2 AC4; US3 AC1; US3 AC2; US3 AC5
Title: Validate CL indicators for Ontario
Description: Validate that an Ontario CL policy and associated claim use values in the inclusive 900-999 range for policy vehicle_ind, claim vehicle_ind, and claim first_party_vehicle_ind with populated and null RIN cases.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare distinct CL policy/claim records with COMMERCIAL_IND = 'C' and risk province ON. Include populated-RIN and null-RIN cases for policy and claim processing. Record unique identifiers and generated outputs.
Steps: 1. Verify each record has COMMERCIAL_IND = 'C' and province ON. 2. Verify both RIN conditions are represented. 3. Generate/process policy and claim records. 4. Inspect policy vehicle_ind, claim vehicle_ind, and claim first_party_vehicle_ind for both RIN conditions. 5. Validate the inclusive range 900-999 and check for the former 000 value.
Expected Results: All three applicable indicators are in 900-999 for both RIN conditions; none is 000; values are associated with the correct Ontario records. No exact populated-RIN mapping is asserted.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC1; US1 AC2; US3 AC6
Title: Confirm non-CL policy indicators retain existing behavior
Description: Confirm the CL-only rule does not change policy indicators when COMMERCIAL_IND is not C.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a non-CL policy with COMMERCIAL_IND other than C. Capture expected existing vehicle_ind from an approved baseline or control process. Use a province/RIN setup suitable for comparison.
Steps: 1. Verify COMMERCIAL_IND is not C. 2. Capture baseline/control policy vehicle_ind. 3. Run the changed policy indicator process with the same input conditions. 4. Compare the result to the approved baseline/control result.
Expected Results: The CL-specific rule is not applied and policy vehicle_ind matches approved existing behavior. No new non-CL indicator value is inferred.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC1; US1 AC2; US3 AC6
Title: Confirm non-CL claim indicators retain existing behavior
Description: Confirm the CL-only rule does not change claim indicators when COMMERCIAL_IND is not C.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a non-CL claim with COMMERCIAL_IND other than C. Capture expected existing claim vehicle_ind and first_party_vehicle_ind from an approved baseline or control process.
Steps: 1. Verify COMMERCIAL_IND is not C. 2. Capture baseline/control values for both claim indicators. 3. Run the changed claim indicator process with the same input conditions. 4. Compare both results to approved baseline/control values.
Expected Results: Neither claim indicator receives the CL-specific change; both match approved existing behavior. No specific non-CL values are assumed.

Title: Confirm unlisted CL province behavior is unchanged
Description: Verify that the new rules do not introduce an unsupported value for a CL province outside the two source-listed groups.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a CL policy and claim with a valid risk province outside ON, NB, NL, NS, PE, AB, NT, NU, and YT. Capture approved existing output or baseline values for applicable indicators.
Steps: 1. Verify CL classification and the province is outside both listed groups. 2. Identify approved baseline behavior. 3. Generate/process the policy and claim under changed logic. 4. Compare resulting values with baseline.
Expected Results: No listed-province rule is applied; values match approved existing behavior. This case does not define missing, blank, or invalid province behavior.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC3; US2 AC1; US2 AC2; US3 AC1; US3 AC2; US3 AC3; US3 AC4
Title: Verify correct province and record association in mixed batch
Description: Detect cross-record contamination by processing multiple CL policies/claims with different applicable provinces and validating each result against its own input.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare uniquely identifiable CL policy/claim records in one batch, including at least one 900-999 group province and one 999 group province. Include a null RIN in the 900-999 group. Record expected input/output mapping.
Steps: 1. Verify each input's unique key, COMMERCIAL_IND, province, and RIN. 2. Process records together. 3. Match each output to its input using implementation keys. 4. For ON/NB/NL/NS/PE records validate applicable indicators in 900-999. 5. For AB/NT/NU/YT records validate applicable indicators equal 999. 6. Check no output uses another record's province or RIN.
Expected Results: Every output is associated with its correct input and follows that record's province and RIN conditions; no cross-record data changes an indicator.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC3; US2 AC1; US2 AC2; US2 AC3; US2 AC4; US3 AC1; US3 AC2; US3 AC4; US3 AC5
Title: Reconcile 900-999 CL indicators with database-backed data
Description: Reconcile database-staged or persisted indicator values with source data and generated outputs for every province in the 900-999 group.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare CL policy and claim records for ON, NB, NL, NS, and PE. Include populated and null RIN cases. Identify actual database-backed locations and record keys using the implementation schema. Retain generated outputs.
Steps: 1. Process records and retain output identifiers. 2. Inspect corresponding database-backed records using actual keys/schema. 3. Confirm stored classification, province, and RIN match source. 4. Compare stored policy vehicle_ind, claim vehicle_ind, and claim first_party_vehicle_ind with generated outputs. 5. Validate all applicable values are in 900-999 for both RIN conditions and are not 000. 6. Verify correct record association.
Expected Results: Stored/staged values match generated outputs and correct source records. All applicable fields are in 900-999 for each listed province including null-RIN cases, and none is 000. No exact populated-RIN mapping or schema name is assumed.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC3; US2 AC2; US2 AC3; US3 AC3; US3 AC4; US3 AC5
Title: Reconcile 999 CL indicators with database-backed data
Description: Confirm database-backed policy and claim indicators are 999 for each province in the second rule group.

Steps: 1. Process prepared records and retain output identifiers. 2. Locate corresponding stored/staged records using implementation keys. 3. Verify stored classification and risk province. 4. Compare stored indicators to generated outputs. 5. Confirm policy vehicle_ind, claim vehicle_ind, and claim first_party_vehicle_ind are each 999 and not 000; verify record association.
Expected Results: All three applicable database-backed indicators equal 999 for all four provinces and match generated outputs and correct source records. No schema-specific table or column names are assumed.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC3; US2 AC1; US2 AC2; US2 AC3; US3 AC1; US3 AC2; US3 AC3; US3 AC4; US3 AC5
Title: Verify database values preserve three-digit indicators
Description: Check that database storage and retrieval do not truncate, coerce, or otherwise alter three-digit indicator values.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare CL records that produce representative permitted values including 999 and values in 900-999. Identify actual database-backed fields and supported read path. Do not force an exact range value unless approved mapping defines it.
Steps: 1. Process prepared records. 2. Capture indicators in generated output. 3. Read corresponding database-backed values through the normal retrieval path. 4. Compare stored/retrieved values according to the defined field type/output contract. 5. Verify three-digit representation and applicable range or exact 999 rule.
Expected Results: Storage and retrieval preserve expected indicator values without truncation or unintended coercion. 999 remains 999; range values remain three digit and within 900-999. No specific schema or type is assumed.

Title: Verify policy-to-claim indicator consistency
Description: Compare policy and associated claim indicators for CL records under matching province and RIN conditions.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepare a CL policy and associated claim for a 900-999 group province and a 999 group province. Include a null-RIN case in the range group. Identify approved policy-claim relationships.
Steps: 1. Verify related policy and claim have matching applicable CL and province conditions. 2. Generate/process policy and claim statistical data. 3. Compare policy vehicle_ind with claim vehicle_ind and first_party_vehicle_ind. 4. Validate range-group values are in 900-999 and second-group values are 999. 5. Where available, repeat comparison on stored/staged values using actual keys.
Expected Results: Policy and associated claim indicators follow the same applicable CL province rule and match the correct records. No unsupported exact RIN mapping is asserted.
